# How to add a webhook

Run `hooks add URL` with any of these flags.

| Flag | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| --events | list | all |
| --secret | string | none |
| --retries | integer | 3 |
| --timeout | integer | 10 |
| --format | string | json |
| --active | boolean | true |
